h:
一个简单的 Flux 图像生成和 img-to-img 工作流程，适合喜欢花钱的人更多时间创作和配置时间更少。

我原来的工作流程集与新版本的 comfy 不同（以及对我的潜在节点的更新，更改了节点名称，哈哈）。不管怎样，我没有更新旧的工作流程，而是花时间进行了一些改进，以确保更好的整体、以提示为中心的体验。

您将需要一些额外的节点，在舒适的管理器中转到'manager'>安装缺少的自定义节点这应该可以解决问题。

如果管理器未安装节点，您可以从此处手动下载它们（不过，您应该首先检查 comfyui 是否已完全更新）：
- https://github.com/Tenos-ai/Tenos-Resize-to-1-M-Pixels

- https://github.com/BobsBlazed/Bobs_Latent_Optimizer

工作流程亮点：

  • 易于使用的宽高比

  • 批量图像

  • 简单的基础图像百万像素选择

  • 动态瓷砖高档

  • 图像到图像输入优化

o.en:
A simple Flux image gen and img-to-img workflow for people who prefer to spendmore time creatingandless time configuring.

My original set of workflows broke with the new version of comfy (and an update to my latent node that changed the node name lol). Anyway, rather than updating the old workflows, I took the time to make some improvements to ensure a better overall, prompting-focused experience.

You will need some additional nodes, in the comfy manager go to'manager'>install missing custom nodesand that should do the trick.

In the event the manager does not install the nodes you can download them manually from here (you should check that comfyui is fully updated first though):
- https://github.com/Tenos-ai/Tenos-Resize-to-1-M-Pixels

- https://github.com/BobsBlazed/Bobs_Latent_Optimizer

Try myFlux prompt craft GPT

Workflow Highlights:

  • Easy-to-use aspect ratio

  • Batch images

  • Simple base image megapixel selection

  • Dynamic tiled upscale

  • Image-to-image input optimization
